verdicts.reason: A breaks the original grouping. The headline sits alone on the left. 'Out now.' has moved off the headline and dangles to the right of the CTA as an orphan. The Try It button is jammed against the bottom of the product circle, so the right side is a cramped stack while the middle is dead space, and the reading order is muddled. B keeps the original order (product, then headline, subline and CTA), and the text column shares a clean left edge with good hierarchy. Its only flaws are minor: the large circle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and the right margin is a bit empty.
